title: Dedicated autoscaler: burst controls + utilization reporting enhancement
author: Nina Patel
release_notes: Enhanced dedicated autoscaler: add token-bucket burst smoothing, per-fleet utilization reporting metrics, and dashboard/alert updates. Backwards compatible; rollout behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: customers on Dedicated fleets see transient load spikes which exhaust burst budgets and produce noisy utilization signals. This PR introduces token-bucket smoothing for burst controls, richer per-fleet utilization reporting (queueing, effective throughput, burst consumption), and wiring for dashboards/alerts. Changes are behind a feature flag and include end-to-end tests and a migration note. Summary of changes: 1) Autoscaler: implement token-bucket smoothing and configurable smoothing window + leak rate; 2) Reporting: emit per-fleet metrics (redwood.dedicated.fleet.utilization, redwood.dedicated.fleet.burst_consumed, redwood.dedicated.fleet.queue_length) with labels for region/pool/model_variant; 3) CLI/Config: new policy knobs (burst_smoothing.window_ms, burst_smoothing.alpha) and safe defaults; 4) Observability: dashboards + alert docs; 5) Tests: unit tests for smoothing math, integration tests for metric emission, load test harness update; 6) Rollout: feature-flag gate and an incremental canary plan in Linear ENG-3245. Backwards compatibility: default settings preserve previous behavior. See linked Linear tickets and SUP-1123 for customer impact notes.

feat(metrics): emit per-fleet utilization and burst consumption metrics

ci_summary: CI: unit tests (linux) — pass; integration (metrics smoke) — pass in canary; lint — pass; load-tests — queued but not required for merge. One flaky test (exporter_prometheus_test.TestExportRetries) was retried and passed.
merge_summary: Merged after approvals and green CI. Feature gated; ops runbook and dashboard links added. Rollout to 10% fleets for first 24h then ramp based on utilization regressions.
ops_notes: Feature flag: dedicated.autoscaler.burst_smoothing (off by default). Suggested defaults: window_ms=10000, alpha=0.3. Monitor redwood.dedicated.fleet.utilization (p95) and redwood.dedicated.fleet.burst_consumed; set alert if utilization increases >8% after rollout.
docs_change_summary: Added docs/dedicated/autoscaling.md: describes new knobs, tuning recommendations, migration notes, and dashboard screenshots. Updated README with canary instructions.
changelog_entry: Enhanced dedicated autoscaler with burst smoothing and improved utilization reporting. Rollout behind feature flag; consult docs/dedicated/autoscaling.md for upgrade steps.
